text: Quantum economics rejects the classical premise of deterministic outcomes and stable equilibrium, treating indeterminacy and fluctuation as intrinsic properties of economic systems rather than as noise around an equilibrium path.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and the Future of Work (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900880

isBasedOn.name: Quantum Economy and the Future of Work

abstract: In contrast to classical economics, which assumes deterministic outcomes and stable equilibria, quantum economics recognizes the inherent indeterminacy and fluctuations in economic systems.
